method_outcomes.B18: Proved a reference-chaos bridge: if Lambda_n(d) is the one-sided Q-to-reference L2 inflation on degree d, then the reference spectral mass through d is at most Lambda_n(d) times source LDA squared. Combined this with a degree-diagonal reversible noise semigroup to prove a quantitative TV-convergence theorem with explicit inflation and global-complexity exponents.
method_outcomes.B6: Removed the predecessor's global pointwise lower-density assumption. On the Boolean cube, Lambda_n(d) is bounded above by the L-infinity norm of the degree-2d truncation of dQ/dU, yielding an explicit nonproduct-null sufficient theorem and a sharp noise-threshold condition 2t>max(eta,beta).
method_outcomes.B21: Ported the exact theorem to Gaussian Hermite/Ornstein-Uhlenbeck chaos and wrote a source-preserving supporting handoff for the P08/P09 Gaussian roles. Hsieh et al. 2601.05850 remains close positive prior art; no ownership or novelty claim transferred.
